use default

use MEMBER = (key: string, value: Json)

union Json is
    TEXT(value: string)
    ARRAY(items: List[Json])
    OBJECT(members: List[MEMBER])
si

union Resolved is
    FOUND(value: Json) default
    FAILED(reason: string)
si

text(value: string) -> Json => Json.TEXT(value)
member(key: string, value: Json) -> MEMBER => (key = key, value = value)

render(value: Json) -> string =>
    case value
    when leaf: Json.TEXT then "\"{leaf.value}\""
    when list: Json.ARRAY then
        "[{list.items |> map(render) |> join(", ")}]"
    when record: Json.OBJECT then
        "{{" "{record.members |> map(render_member) |> join(", ")}" "}}"
    esac

render_member(entry: MEMBER) -> string =>
    "\"{entry.key}\": {render(entry.value)}"

as_index(token: string) -> int? =>
    if token.length > 0 /\
        (token |> all(digit => digit >= '0' /\ digit <= '9')) then
        int.parse(token)
    else
        null
    fi

step(node: Json, token: string) -> Resolved =>
    case node
    when list: Json.ARRAY then
        if let position = as_index(token) then
            if position < list.items.count then
                Resolved.FOUND(list.items[position])
            else
                Resolved.FAILED("index {position} is past the end")
            fi
        else
            Resolved.FAILED("\"{token}\" is not an array index")
        fi
    when record: Json.OBJECT then
        let named = record.members |> find(entry => entry.key =~ token) in
        if let found = named then
            Resolved.FOUND(found.value)
        else
            Resolved.FAILED("no member named \"{token}\"")
        fi
    else
        Resolved.FAILED("\"{token}\" has nothing to descend into")
    esac

decode(token: string) -> string =>
    token.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~")

resolve(document: Json, pointer: string) -> Resolved =>
    if pointer.length == 0 then
        Resolved.FOUND(document)
    elif pointer[0] != '/' then
        Resolved.FAILED("a pointer must be empty or start with a slash")
    else
        pointer[1..<0]
            .split(['/'])
            |> reduce(Resolved.FOUND(document), (running, token) =>
                if running? then
                    step(running.value, decode(token))
                else
                    running
                fi)
    fi

let wiki_link = "https://rosettacode.org/wiki/Rosetta_Code"
let discord_link = "https://discord.com/channels/1011262808001880065"

let document =
    Json.OBJECT(
        [member("wiki", Json.OBJECT(
             [member("links", Json.ARRAY(
                  [text(wiki_link), text(discord_link)]))])),
         member("", text("Rosetta")),
         member(" ", text("Code")),
         member("g/h", text("chrestomathy")),
         member("i~j", text("site")),
         member("abc", Json.ARRAY([text("is"), text("a")])),
         member("def", Json.OBJECT([member("", text("programming"))]))])

let pointers =
    ["", "/", "/ ", "/abc", "/def/", "/g~1h", "/i~0j",
     "/wiki/links/0", "/wiki/links/1", "/wiki/links/2",
     "/wiki/name", "/no/such/thing", "bad/pointer"]

pointers |> each(pointer => (
    let outcome = resolve(document, pointer)

    if outcome? then
        write_line("\"{pointer}\" -> {render(outcome.value)}")
    else
        write_line("\"{pointer}\" -> error: {outcome.reason}")
    fi
))

use default

use MEMBER = (key: string, value: Json)

union Json is
    TEXT(value: string)
    ARRAY(items: List[Json])
    OBJECT(members: List[MEMBER])
si

union Resolved is
    FOUND(value: Json) default
    FAILED(reason: string)
si

text(value: string) -> Json => Json.TEXT(value)
member(key: string, value: Json) -> MEMBER => (key = key, value = value)

render(value: Json) -> string =>
    case value
    when leaf: Json.TEXT then "\"{leaf.value}\""
    when list: Json.ARRAY then
        "[{list.items |> map(render) |> join(", ")}]"
    when record: Json.OBJECT then
        "{{" "{record.members |> map(render_member) |> join(", ")}" "}}"
    esac

render_member(entry: MEMBER) -> string =>
    "\"{entry.key}\": {render(entry.value)}"

as_index(token: string) -> int? =>
    if token.length > 0 /\
        (token |> all(digit => digit >= '0' /\ digit <= '9')) then
        int.parse(token)
    else
        null
    fi

step(node: Json, token: string) -> Resolved =>
    case node
    when list: Json.ARRAY then
        if let position = as_index(token) then
            if position < list.items.count then
                Resolved.FOUND(list.items[position])
            else
                Resolved.FAILED("index {position} is past the end")
            fi
        else
            Resolved.FAILED("\"{token}\" is not an array index")
        fi
    when record: Json.OBJECT then
        let named = record.members |> find(entry => entry.key =~ token) in
        if let found = named then
            Resolved.FOUND(found.value)
        else
            Resolved.FAILED("no member named \"{token}\"")
        fi
    else
        Resolved.FAILED("\"{token}\" has nothing to descend into")
    esac

decode(token: string) -> string =>
    token.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~")

resolve(document: Json, pointer: string) -> Resolved =>
    if pointer.length == 0 then
        Resolved.FOUND(document)
    elif pointer[0] != '/' then
        Resolved.FAILED("a pointer must be empty or start with a slash")
    else
        pointer[1..<0]
            .split(['/'])
            |> reduce(Resolved.FOUND(document), (running, token) =>
                if running? then
                    step(running.value, decode(token))
                else
                    running
                fi)
    fi

let wiki_link = "https://rosettacode.org/wiki/Rosetta_Code"
let discord_link = "https://discord.com/channels/1011262808001880065"

let document =
    Json.OBJECT(
        [member("wiki", Json.OBJECT(
             [member("links", Json.ARRAY(
                  [text(wiki_link), text(discord_link)]))])),
         member("", text("Rosetta")),
         member(" ", text("Code")),
         member("g/h", text("chrestomathy")),
         member("i~j", text("site")),
         member("abc", Json.ARRAY([text("is"), text("a")])),
         member("def", Json.OBJECT([member("", text("programming"))]))])

let pointers =
    ["", "/", "/ ", "/abc", "/def/", "/g~1h", "/i~0j",
     "/wiki/links/0", "/wiki/links/1", "/wiki/links/2",
     "/wiki/name", "/no/such/thing", "bad/pointer"]

pointers |> each(pointer => (
    let outcome = resolve(document, pointer)

    if outcome? then
        write_line("\"{pointer}\" -> {render(outcome.value)}")
    else
        write_line("\"{pointer}\" -> error: {outcome.reason}")
    fi
))
